item.text: {"results":[{"pair_id":"J01820","case1_error":"Uses the final tank population as the initial population when calculating fish caught, yielding 16 instead of 8.","case2_error":"Treats $1 per 10 beads as $1 per bead, yielding $1800 instead of $180.","reason":"The first confuses initial and final populations; the second fails to convert a batch price into a unit price.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J01821","case1_error":"Omits the nine incoming fish from the total before halving, then arbitrarily rounds the resulting half-fish amount.","case2_error":"Treats the $2 price for five cans as the price for one can.","reason":"Omitting an incoming quantity and arbitrarily rounding differ from misinterpreting a batch price as a unit price.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J01822","case1_error":"Reduces the required rope length by 25% instead of accounting for the reduced usable length of purchased rope.","case2_error":"Adds the five lost points to earned points instead of subtracting them.","reason":"The first applies a percentage loss to the wrong quantity when solving backward; the second reverses the sign of a stated loss.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J01823","case1_error":"Adds the 43 books elsewhere in the house to the stated collection instead of including them among donated books.","case2_error":"No clear error: $140 correctly totals four weekly deposits; the phrase 'a month from now' leaves the counting interval ambiguous.","reason":"The savings solution supports a plausible cumulative interpretation. The reference's $60 is a weekly deposit amount, so it cannot establish a clear error.","judgment":"uncertain"},{"pair_id":"J01824","case1_error":"Constructs invalid beaver-per-human and moose-per-human ratios, obtaining 9.5 moose per human instead of 1/38.","case2_error":"Adds the six sold cows instead of subtracting them, inflating the final herd by twelve.","reason":"Invalid ratio construction differs from treating an outgoing quantity as an addition.","judgment":"different"}]}
